normalFinding.default: Radial pulse {vitals.hr} beats/min, regular rhythm, normal volume.

steps: Place two finger pads over the radial artery at the wrist.
Count beats for at least 15 seconds and convert to a per-minute rate.

normalFinding.default: Respiratory rate {vitals.rr} breaths/min, quiet and unlaboured.

steps: Watch the chest rise without telling the patient you are counting.
Count breaths for at least 15 seconds and convert to a per-minute rate.

maneuvers.label: BP: choose cuff size and place over brachial artery

normalFinding.default: Appropriately sized cuff applied snugly to the bare upper arm, bladder centred over the palpated brachial artery.

steps: Pick a cuff whose bladder suits the arm circumference.
Feel for the brachial pulse in the antecubital fossa.
Wrap the cuff snugly on bare skin with the bladder over the artery.

maneuvers.label: BP: flex and support the arm

normalFinding.default: Arm slightly flexed and supported at heart level.

steps: Rest the arm on a surface or your own arm so the patient is relaxed.

maneuvers.label: BP: palpatory estimate, then auscultatory reading

steps: Inflate while feeling the radial pulse; note where it disappears, then deflate fully and wait.
Place the stethoscope over the brachial artery.
Inflate 20–30 mmHg above the palpated value and deflate slowly (about 2–3 mmHg per second).
Record when tapping sounds start and when they stop.

steps.label: Wrap the cuff on the bare upper arm, lower edge 2–3 cm above the elbow crease
Support the arm at heart level
Feel the brachial pulse in the elbow crease
Inflate, release slowly (2–3 mmHg per second) and record the reading

steps: Clip the probe onto a fingertip.
Wait for a steady waveform before reading.
Measure temperature with the available thermometer.

normalFinding.default: Well-appearing adult, comfortable at rest, alert and conversant, well groomed, no acute distress.

steps: Step back and observe the whole patient before touching them.
Note build, nutrition, grooming, comfort, mood and how they interact with the room.
